text: In MLTT, what distinguishes large elimination from small elimination?
choices: Large elimination allows the motive to range over types (𝒰), not just propositions
Large elimination applies to larger data structures
Small elimination is only for propositions
explanation: Large elimination: ind returns a type (motive has type T→𝒰). Small: motive is T→Prop. Large is needed, e.g., to convert between Bool and 2-element types.
